name: Zaffiro EVO

origin.basis: Italian bicycle-tire brand; Vittoria's international store is set to Italy (EUR).

manufacturing.basis: The store pages do not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Vittoria's low-cost training, touring and commuting clincher.
weight_basis: Vittoria store weights for black sidewalls.

availability.note: Sold by Vittoria's international web store in euros; mainland China and North American availability not verified for this line.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. Italian VAT on 2026-11-01; shipping calculated at checkout. One tire.

caveats: Bicycle Rolling Resistance's 2020 Zaffiro Pro test is an earlier model and is not applied.
